artifact.category_tag: functional equations in a single variable
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \ldots\}$. Characterize all sequences $k : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ for which there exists a function $\varphi : \mathbb{N} \to (0, \infty)$ satisfying the recurrence
$$\varphi(n) = \varphi(n+1) + \varphi(k(n)) \quad \text{for every } n \in \mathbb{N}.$$
That is, give necessary and sufficient conditions on the sequence $k$ such that the above functional equation admits a strictly positive solution $\varphi$.
